_note: Act 1's shape (docs/plans/rebuild-phase5-run.md, sections 2 and 3, Decisions 5 and 11). Each day is normal (an easier and a harder fight), elite (two elites), or boss. Pay is shards for a win (a tie pays like a win), by the fight's tier. The pick: "Take 3 shards instead" pays pick_shards; wild_card_pct is how often one of its cards is for any hero instead of one each (part 6). All numbers are tuning values. Phase 5c step 5a (docs/plans/economy.md, relics/README.md): the economy's numbers, relics by tier, the shops' tier odds, rerolls that climb from reroll (boss_reroll in the boss shop, after the boss: Decision 48 of rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, which also made the boss pay 60), the Magpie's relics at magpie_relic_pct of the price, an elite's chance of an epic, and the boss relics offered. A Hunt's pay and pick_shards aren't set in economy.md (placeholders).

endless._note: Endless after the boss (phase 8 part 1, docs/plans/rebuild-phase8-endless.md): a floor is a day; enemies x1.15 HP and ATK a floor, a rift modifier every 3 floors for good, Rift Collapse 1s earlier a floor (never before 10s) and crumbled ground x1.15 a floor, the boss every 10th floor and an elite every other 5th, fights from day 4 on (Decision 1), a legendary in the shops from floor 10.
